name: encoding-reflection-self-encoding
description: A destination that reads fields does not read the fields of a type whose method set holds the encoding method it calls for its direction, MarshalJSON, MarshalJSONTo or MarshalText for a JSON encoder, MarshalXML or MarshalText for XML, GobEncode or MarshalBinary for gob, and does not walk on through them. A method with a pointer receiver counts only where every value of the type the walk meets is addressable. So a field the method does not read, and a type reached only through such a field, are reported as written and never read, while a value encoded as a value, whose pointer-receiver method the encoder cannot call, keeps its fields.
